claims.text: Every pt w acute pelvic pain: CBC, UA and a preg test.
claims.quote: All female patients with acute pelvic pain should have Complete blood count (CBC) Urinalysis Pregnancy test

claims.text: (+) preg test w pain or bleed: assume ectopic preg until transvaginal US or other tests exclude it.
claims.quote: If a patient has a positive pregnancy test and has pain or bleeding, ectopic pregnancy is assumed until excluded by transvaginal ultrasound (finding no fetal pole or yolk sac) or, if ultrasound is unclear, by other tests.

claims.text: Transvaginal US can show a ruptured ovarian cyst (cyst w echogenic fluid), adnexal torsion (mass, often > 5 cm, w ⍉Doppler flow) or a tubo-ovarian abscess (complex multilocular mass).
claims.quote: Transvaginal ultrasound may also identify or suggest other etiologies of acute pain, including Ruptured ovarian cyst: Ovarian cyst with echogenic pelvic fluid Adnexal torsion: Ovarian or fallopian tube mass (particularly if mass is > 5 cm) with absence of Doppler flow Complex multilocular adnexal mass: Tubo-ovarian abscess

claims.text: Sus appendicitis: CT of the abd and pelvis.
claims.quote: If appendicitis is suspected, a pelvic and abdominal CT scan should be performed.

claims.text: Preg w sus bleed: blood type and Rh; if unstable, cross-match plus fibrinogen, fibrin split prod and PT/PTT.
claims.quote: If the patient also has vaginal bleeding or suspected internal bleeding, blood type and Rh typing are done. If there is hemodynamic instability (with hypotension, persistent tachycardia, or both), blood should be cross-matched, and fibrinogen level, fibrin split products, and prothrombin time/partial thromboplastin time (PT/PTT) are determined.

claims.text: Sus ectopic: draw renal and hepatic funct tests early, since they're needed b4 MTX.
claims.quote: If ectopic pregnancy is suspected, renal and hepatic function tests may be drawn in advance, since these will be needed to exclude renal or hepatic disease before methotrexate is administered.

claims.text: Unstable w a (+) preg test: don't delay surg for US.
claims.quote: However, ultrasound can and should be deferred, as needed, to expedite surgical treatment in the hemodynamically unstable patient with a positive pregnancy test, given the very high likelihood of either ectopic pregnancy or spontaneous abortion with hemorrhage.
